cards.title: Survival basics
cards.description: Preserve your oxygen, health and try to gather new resources

cards.title: Oxygen
cards.description: The key to your success, use it wisely, you can gather it back by mining ice cubes and using them inside oxygen generator.

cards.title: Exploration
cards.description: Exploration is a smart choice for finding new resources, but be sure that you have enough oxygen for your expedition.

cards.title: Iron Chunk
cards.description: Iron ore that can be smelted into the ingot.

cards.title: Copper Chunk
cards.description: Copper ore that can be smelted into the ingot.

cards.title: Iron Ingot
cards.description: Basic metal, useful for a lot of recipes.

cards.title: Basic Wire
cards.description: Used to connect machines and electricity circuits together.

cards.title: Basic tools
cards.description: Combine common materials to create tools for gathering and exploration.

cards.title: Survival supplies
cards.description: Craft supplies that help you stay safe and keep moving across the planet.

cards.title: Basic solar panel
cards.description: Machine that produces the electricity. Can be connected using wires.

cards.title: Oxygen generator
cards.description: Generate oxygen and extend the amount of time you can spend outside. It uses ice cubes and electricity or coal
